def VTask.evenOddRec {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} (h0 : P 0) 
  (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) 
  (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) 
  (n : ℕ) : P n := 
  if n == 0 then
    h0
  else if n % 2 == 0 then
    let k := n / 2
    h_even k (VTask.evenOddRec h0 h_even h_odd k)
  else
    let k := n / 2
    h_odd k (VTask.evenOddRec h0 h_even h_odd k)
